data.summary: Rules that let units redeploy once both armies are set up are resolved in this step unless they state otherwise. Players alternate, the Attacker first. A unit put into **[strategic reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)** here is left out of your **[strategic reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)** points total.

detail.excludedFromStrategicReservesPoints: units moved into strategic reserves during redeployment
